description: This source file contains the implementation of the CountryService interface, including methods for retrieving country data, adding descriptions, and caching country information in a Spring-based application.

classes.name: CountryServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing country-related business logic, including caching and database access methods for Country entities.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Country entity by its ISO code.

methods.name: addCountryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a country and updates it.

methods.name: getCountriesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of country ISO codes to Country objects for a given language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries matching given ISO codes and language.

methods.name: getCountries (with language parameter)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all countries for a specified language, utilizing caching.
